title: Kenyan Chicken Biryani
description: Hearty and flavorful, this chicken biryani is a twist on traditional Kenyan cuisine. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: spices
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1 teaspoon turmeric, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the spices, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to package instructions.
To assemble the biryani, place a layer of rice in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Add a layer of the chicken mixture on top of the rice.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of rice on top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
